metadata.title: Sentry V8 forward regression and edge-case test matrix
metadata.delivery_boundary: CV complete multipart package to compatible delivery-agent POST /v1/packages and its acknowledgement; real agent storage/Management are outside current authorization
metadata.default_tls_mode: legacy-compatible, explicitly user-authorized; strict mode optional
notes: This is a catalog, not282 executable tests or completed runs. One controlled scenario can cover several case IDs.
All execution statuses start NOT_RUN; prior evidence is separately scoped and is not a fresh passing verdict.
Known failures stay open and unsupported/inactive capabilities do not become supported because a negative test passed.
The approved policy/contract and independently prepared expected timeline are the oracle; do not derive expected results by reusing the production implementation.
